Package com.composum.platform.commons.json

Class AbstractJsonRpcClient<T extends JsonRpcInterface>

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.composum.platform.commons.json.AbstractJsonRpcClient<T>
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    InvocationHandler
    public abstract class AbstractJsonRpcClient<T extends JsonRpcInterface>
extends Object
implements InvocationHandler
    Deprecated.
    not yet tested
    Base class for servlets that provides in conjunction with AbstractJsonRpcClient "remote procedure calls" from a Sling server to another Sling server via the usual Sling Servlets and Gson serialization of the arguments. A description of the needed constraints is given at JsonRpcInterface.
